title: Everyday English Word Quest A1–A2
description: Build practical A1–A2 vocabulary in definitions and real usage contexts for school, home, food, feelings, actions, and places.

units.title: Daily Foundations
units.description: Useful vocabulary for school, home, and meals.

lessons.title: School
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, precise usage, grammar, ordering, and a matching review.

challenges.question: Which word means “a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution”?
challenges.explanation: “student” means a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution. Example: The student asked a thoughtful question during the lesson.

challenges.question: Which word means “a person whose occupation is teaching”?
challenges.explanation: “teacher” means a person whose occupation is teaching. Example: The teacher explained the new idea with a clear example.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “The _____ became quiet when the lesson began.”
challenges.explanation: “classroom” means a room in a school where lessons take place. Example: The classroom became quiet when the lesson began.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Today's _____ introduces the water cycle.”
challenges.explanation: “lesson” means a unit of instruction. Example: Today's lesson introduces the water cycle.

challenges.question: Which word means “preparatory school work done outside school (especially at home)”?
challenges.explanation: “homework” means preparatory school work done outside school (especially at home). Example: I finished my homework before dinner.

challenges.question: Which word means “a room where books are kept”?
challenges.explanation: “library” means a room where books are kept. Example: We borrowed two science books from the library.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “Use a _____ so you can correct your work easily.”
challenges.explanation: “pencil” means a thin cylindrical pointed writing implement. Example: Use a pencil so you can correct your work easily.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “She recorded each new word in her _____.”
challenges.explanation: “notebook” means a book with blank pages for recording notes or memoranda. Example: She recorded each new word in her notebook.

challenges.question: Which word means “a sentence or request that asks for information”?
challenges.explanation: “question” means a sentence or request that asks for information. Example: Mina raised her hand to ask a question.

challenges.question: Which word means “a reply to a question or a solution to a problem”?
challenges.explanation: “answer” means a reply to a question or a solution to a problem. Example: Check your answer before submitting the worksheet.

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this lesson?
challenges.explanation: “family” comes from a different lesson; the rest of this set is “student”, “teacher”, “classroom”.

challenges.question: Put this example sentence about “teacher” back in the correct order.
Match each word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “student” means a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution. “teacher” means a person whose occupation is teaching. “classroom” means a room in a school where lessons take place. “lesson” means a unit of instruction.

lessons.title: Home
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, precise usage, grammar, ordering, and a matching review.

challenges.question: Which word means “a social unit living together”?
challenges.explanation: “family” means a social unit living together. Example: Her family eats dinner together every Friday.

challenges.question: Which word means “a mother, father, or person who cares for a child”?
challenges.explanation: “parent” means a mother, father, or person who cares for a child. Example: A parent signed the school permission form.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “The _____ read the short story aloud.”
challenges.explanation: “child” means a young person of either sex. Example: The child read the short story aloud.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “We prepared breakfast together in the _____.”
challenges.explanation: “kitchen” means a room equipped for preparing meals. Example: We prepared breakfast together in the kitchen.

challenges.question: Which word means “a room used primarily for sleeping”?
challenges.explanation: “bedroom” means a room used primarily for sleeping. Example: He opened the bedroom window to let in fresh air.

challenges.question: Which word means “an opening in a wall or roof fitted with glass to admit light or air”?
challenges.explanation: “window” means an opening in a wall or roof fitted with glass to admit light or air. Example: Sunlight came through the classroom window.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “The students planted herbs in the school _____.”
challenges.explanation: “garden” means a piece of land where flowers, fruit, or vegetables are grown. Example: The students planted herbs in the school garden.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “A healthy _____ can help learners concentrate.”
challenges.explanation: “breakfast” means the first meal of the day (usually in the morning). Example: A healthy breakfast can help learners concentrate.

challenges.question: Which word means “the main meal of the day served in the evening or at midday”?
challenges.explanation: “dinner” means the main meal of the day served in the evening or at midday. Example: We talked about our day during dinner.

challenges.question: Which word means “received with pleasure or friendly approval”?
challenges.explanation: “welcome” means received with pleasure or friendly approval. Example: The new student received a warm welcome.

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this lesson?
challenges.explanation: “apple” comes from a different lesson; the rest of this set is “family”, “parent”, “child”.

challenges.question: Put this example sentence about “bedroom” back in the correct order.
Match each word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “family” means a social unit living together. “parent” means a mother, father, or person who cares for a child. “child” means a young person of either sex. “kitchen” means a room equipped for preparing meals.

lessons.title: Food and Drink
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, precise usage, grammar, ordering, and a matching review.

challenges.question: Which word means “fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh”?
challenges.explanation: “apple” means fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh. Example: She packed an apple for her morning snack.

challenges.question: Which word means “elongated crescent-shaped yellow fruit with soft sweet flesh”?
challenges.explanation: “banana” means elongated crescent-shaped yellow fruit with soft sweet flesh. Example: The banana was ripe and sweet.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “He made a sandwich with fresh _____.”
challenges.explanation: “bread” means food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked. Example: He made a sandwich with fresh bread.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The family served vegetables with _____.”
challenges.explanation: “rice” means grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished. Example: The family served vegetables with rice.

challenges.question: Which word means “a clear liquid that people, animals, and plants need to live”?
challenges.explanation: “water” means a clear liquid that people, animals, and plants need to live. Example: Remember to drink enough water after exercise.

challenges.question: Which word means “a dark drink made from roasted beans”?
challenges.explanation: “coffee” means a dark drink made from roasted beans. Example: The cafe also serves tea and coffee.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “Carrots are the _____ in today's soup.”
challenges.explanation: “vegetable” means edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant. Example: Carrots are the vegetable in today's soup.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “I felt _____ after the football match.”
challenges.explanation: “hungry” means needing or wanting food. Example: I felt hungry after the football match.

challenges.question: Which word means “having a very pleasant taste or smell”?
challenges.explanation: “delicious” means having a very pleasant taste or smell. Example: The vegetable soup smelled delicious.

challenges.question: Which word means “directions for making something”?
challenges.explanation: “recipe” means directions for making something. Example: The recipe explains how to prepare the dish step by step.

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this lesson?
challenges.explanation: “walk” comes from a different lesson; the rest of this set is “apple”, “banana”, “bread”.

challenges.question: Put this example sentence about “recipe” back in the correct order.
Match each word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “apple” means fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh. “banana” means elongated crescent-shaped yellow fruit with soft sweet flesh. “bread” means food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked. “rice” means grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished.

units.title: People on the Move
units.description: Words for actions, emotions, and getting around.

lessons.title: Actions
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, precise usage, grammar, ordering, and a matching review.

challenges.question: Which word means “the act of traveling by foot”?
challenges.explanation: “walk” means the act of traveling by foot. Example: We walk to the library after lunch.

challenges.question: Which word means “to use your voice to say words”?
challenges.explanation: “speak” means to use your voice to say words. Example: Please speak clearly during your presentation.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “_____ carefully for the main idea.”
challenges.explanation: “listen” means hear with intention. Example: Listen carefully for the main idea.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “_____ your name at the top of the page.”
challenges.explanation: “write” means to form words or symbols on a surface. Example: Write your name at the top of the page.

challenges.question: Which word means “to hold and move something from one place to another”?
challenges.explanation: “carry” means to hold and move something from one place to another. Example: This bag can carry all of my school books.

challenges.question: Which word means “to move something so that it is no longer closed”?
challenges.explanation: “open” means to move something so that it is no longer closed. Example: Please open your book to page ten.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “_____ the door quietly when you leave.”
challenges.explanation: “close” means to shut an opening or bring something to an end. Example: Close the door quietly when you leave.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The assembly will _____ at nine o'clock.”
challenges.explanation: “begin” means to start doing or being something. Example: The assembly will begin at nine o'clock.

challenges.question: Which word means “to complete something or reach its end”?
challenges.explanation: “finish” means to complete something or reach its end. Example: Try to finish the activity before the bell.

challenges.question: Which word means “select as an alternative over another”?
challenges.explanation: “choose” means select as an alternative over another. Example: Choose the strongest evidence for your answer.

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this lesson?
challenges.explanation: “happy” comes from a different lesson; the rest of this set is “walk”, “speak”, “listen”.

challenges.question: Put this example sentence about “write” back in the correct order.
Match each word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “walk” means the act of traveling by foot. “speak” means to use your voice to say words. “listen” means hear with intention. “write” means to form words or symbols on a surface.

lessons.title: Feelings and Character
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, precise usage, grammar, ordering, and a matching review.

challenges.question: Which word means “enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure”?
challenges.explanation: “happy” means enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure. Example: The class felt happy about its progress.

challenges.question: Which word means “experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness”?
challenges.explanation: “sad” means experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness. Example: The ending of the story made him feel sad.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “She felt _____ when the rule was applied unfairly.”
challenges.explanation: “angry” means feeling or showing anger. Example: She felt angry when the rule was applied unfairly.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “He was _____ to speak until his partner encouraged him.”
challenges.explanation: “afraid” means feeling fear or worry. Example: He was afraid to speak until his partner encouraged him.

challenges.question: Which word means “very enthusiastic and eager”?
challenges.explanation: “excited” means very enthusiastic and eager. Example: The students felt excited about the class trip.

challenges.question: Which word means “in need of rest or sleep”?
challenges.explanation: “tired” means in need of rest or sleep. Example: After the long journey, everyone felt tired.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “She stayed _____ and followed the safety instructions.”
challenges.explanation: “calm” means peaceful and not excited, worried, or upset. Example: She stayed calm and followed the safety instructions.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The students were _____ of their community project.”
challenges.explanation: “proud” means feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth. Example: The students were proud of their community project.

challenges.question: Which word means “friendly, generous, and considerate toward others”?
challenges.explanation: “kind” means friendly, generous, and considerate toward others. Example: It was kind of you to help the new learner.

challenges.question: Which word means “ready to face danger or difficulty with courage”?
challenges.explanation: “brave” means ready to face danger or difficulty with courage. Example: The brave student admitted the mistake and corrected it.

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this lesson?
challenges.explanation: “hospital” comes from a different lesson; the rest of this set is “happy”, “sad”, “angry”.

challenges.question: Put this example sentence about “afraid” back in the correct order.
Match each word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “happy” means enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure. “sad” means experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness. “angry” means feeling or showing anger. “afraid” means feeling fear or worry.

lessons.title: Around Town
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, precise usage, grammar, ordering, and a matching review.

challenges.question: Which word means “a health facility where patients receive treatment”?
challenges.explanation: “hospital” means a health facility where patients receive treatment. Example: The ambulance carried the patient to the hospital.

challenges.question: Which word means “a place where people buy and sell goods”?
challenges.explanation: “market” means a place where people buy and sell goods. Example: Farmers sell fresh produce at the weekend market.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “The train arrived at the _____ on time.”
challenges.explanation: “station” means a place where trains or buses regularly stop. Example: The train arrived at the station on time.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “We arrived at the _____ two hours before the flight.”
challenges.explanation: “airport” means an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo. Example: We arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.

challenges.question: Which word means “a building where people go to eat”?
challenges.explanation: “restaurant” means a building where people go to eat. Example: The family reserved a table at the restaurant.

challenges.question: Which word means “a thoroughfare (usually including sidewalks) that is lined with buildings”?
challenges.explanation: “street” means a thoroughfare (usually including sidewalks) that is lined with buildings. Example: Use the crossing when you walk across the street.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “The _____ connects the village to the main road.”
challenges.explanation: “bridge” means a structure carrying a path or road over an obstacle. Example: The bridge connects the village to the main road.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The small _____ has a school and a health clinic.”
challenges.explanation: “village” means a community of people smaller than a town. Example: The small village has a school and a health clinic.

challenges.question: Which word means “the act of traveling from one place to another”?
challenges.explanation: “journey” means the act of traveling from one place to another. Example: Their long journey ended safely at the village.

challenges.question: Which word means “a commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)”?
challenges.explanation: “ticket” means a commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment). Example: Keep your bus ticket until the end of the journey.

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this lesson?
challenges.explanation: “analyze” comes from a different lesson; the rest of this set is “hospital”, “market”, “station”.

challenges.question: Put this example sentence about “airport” back in the correct order.
Match each word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “hospital” means a health facility where patients receive treatment. “market” means a place where people buy and sell goods. “station” means a place where trains or buses regularly stop. “airport” means an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo.

units.title: Study and Research
units.description: Words for thinking, evidence, reading, and writing.

lessons.title: Thinking Skills
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, precise usage, grammar, ordering, and a matching review.

challenges.question: Which word means “consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning”?
challenges.explanation: “analyze” means consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning. Example: Students analyze the results before writing a conclusion.

challenges.question: Which word means “examine and note the similarities or differences of”?
challenges.explanation: “compare” means examine and note the similarities or differences of. Example: Compare the two articles and identify their similarities.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “The essay will _____ city life with village life.”
challenges.explanation: “contrast” means put in opposition to show or emphasize differences. Example: The essay will contrast city life with village life.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Researchers _____ whether the method produced reliable results.”
challenges.explanation: “evaluate” means form a critical opinion of. Example: Researchers evaluate whether the method produced reliable results.

challenges.question: Which word means “make plain and comprehensible”?
challenges.explanation: “explain” means make plain and comprehensible. Example: Use the diagram to explain how the machine works.

challenges.question: Which word means “to reach a conclusion from evidence and reasoning”?
challenges.explanation: “infer” means to reach a conclusion from evidence and reasoning. Example: Readers infer the character's feelings from clues in the story.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “The class will _____ the information shown in the graph.”
challenges.explanation: “interpret” means to explain or understand the meaning of something. Example: The class will interpret the information shown in the graph.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Scientists _____ the plant each day and record any changes.”
challenges.explanation: “observe” means to notice or watch something carefully. Example: Scientists observe the plant each day and record any changes.

challenges.question: Which word means “to say what is likely to happen in the future”?
challenges.explanation: “predict” means to say what is likely to happen in the future. Example: Scientists predict tomorrow's weather using current data.

challenges.question: Which word means “to give the main points in a shorter form”?
challenges.explanation: “summarize” means to give the main points in a shorter form. Example: Summarize the passage in three clear sentences.

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this lesson?
challenges.explanation: “evidence” comes from a different lesson; the rest of this set is “analyze”, “compare”, “contrast”.

Match each word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “analyze” means consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning. “compare” means examine and note the similarities or differences of. “contrast” means put in opposition to show or emphasize differences. “evaluate” means form a critical opinion of.

lessons.title: Evidence and Research
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, precise usage, grammar, ordering, and a matching review.

challenges.question: Which word means “your basis for belief or disbelief”?
challenges.explanation: “evidence” means your basis for belief or disbelief. Example: The writer supports the claim with evidence from the text.

challenges.question: Which word means “systematic investigation to establish facts”?
challenges.explanation: “research” means systematic investigation to establish facts. Example: Their research examines how sleep affects learning.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “Always check whether an online _____ is trustworthy.”
challenges.explanation: “source” means the place, person, or thing from which information comes. Example: Always check whether an online source is trustworthy.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The class organized its survey _____ in a table.”
challenges.explanation: “data” means a collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn. Example: The class organized its survey data in a table.

challenges.question: Which word means “a way of doing something, especially a systematic way”?
challenges.explanation: “method” means a way of doing something, especially a systematic way. Example: The researcher explained the method used in the experiment.

challenges.question: Which word means “the outcome produced by an action or event”?
challenges.explanation: “result” means the outcome produced by an action or event. Example: The final result matched the team's prediction.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “The evidence supports the _____ presented in the article.”
challenges.explanation: “theory” means a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world. Example: The evidence supports the theory presented in the article.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The student council conducted a _____ about school lunches.”
challenges.explanation: “survey” means a detailed critical inspection. Example: The student council conducted a survey about school lunches.

challenges.question: Which word means “a small part chosen to represent a larger whole”?
challenges.explanation: “sample” means a small part chosen to represent a larger whole. Example: The laboratory tested a small sample of river water.

challenges.question: Which word means “a judgment or decision reached after reasoning”?
challenges.explanation: “conclusion” means a judgment or decision reached after reasoning. Example: The conclusion explains what the experiment demonstrated.

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this lesson?
challenges.explanation: “argument” comes from a different lesson; the rest of this set is “evidence”, “research”, “source”.

challenges.explanation: “evidence” means your basis for belief or disbelief. “research” means systematic investigation to establish facts. “source” means the place, person, or thing from which information comes. “data” means a collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn.

lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, precise usage, grammar, ordering, and a matching review.

challenges.question: Which word means “a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true”?
challenges.explanation: “argument” means a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true. Example: A strong argument includes reasons and supporting evidence.

challenges.question: Which word means “one of several distinct subdivisions of a text intended to separate ideas”?
challenges.explanation: “paragraph” means one of several distinct subdivisions of a text intended to separate ideas. Example: Each paragraph should develop one clear main idea.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “Each _____ should express a complete idea.”
challenges.explanation: “sentence” means a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language. Example: Each sentence should express a complete idea.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The surrounding paragraph provides _____ for the unfamiliar word.”
challenges.explanation: “context” means discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation. Example: The surrounding paragraph provides context for the unfamiliar word.

challenges.question: Which word means “a passage or expression that is quoted or cited”?
challenges.explanation: “quotation” means a passage or expression that is quoted or cited. Example: Use a short quotation to support your interpretation.

challenges.question: Which word means “a source used to find or support information”?
challenges.explanation: “reference” means a source used to find or support information. Example: The report includes a reference for every borrowed idea.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “Writers _____ their drafts to make the meaning clearer.”
challenges.explanation: “revise” means make revisions in. Example: Writers revise their drafts to make the meaning clearer.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Her first _____ contained several ideas to develop.”
challenges.explanation: “draft” means an early version of a piece of writing. Example: Her first draft contained several ideas to develop.

challenges.question: Which word means “the branch of linguistics that deals with syntax and morphology (and sometimes also deals with semantics)”?
challenges.explanation: “grammar” means the branch of linguistics that deals with syntax and morphology (and sometimes also deals with semantics). Example: Careful grammar makes formal writing easier to understand.

challenges.question: Which word means “a listing of the words used in some enterprise”?
challenges.explanation: “vocabulary” means a listing of the words used in some enterprise. Example: Reading widely can expand your academic vocabulary.

challenges.explanation: “energy” comes from a different lesson; the rest of this set is “argument”, “paragraph”, “sentence”.

units.title: STEM and Society
units.description: Academic vocabulary across technical and social subjects.

lessons.title: Science
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, precise usage, grammar, ordering, and a matching review.

challenges.question: Which word means “the ability to do work or cause change”?
challenges.explanation: “energy” means the ability to do work or cause change. Example: Solar panels convert sunlight into energy.

challenges.question: Which word means “physical substance from which things are made”?
challenges.explanation: “matter” means physical substance from which things are made. Example: All matter has mass and occupies space.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “Oxygen is an _____ found in air and water.”
challenges.explanation: “element” means a pure substance made from one kind of atom. Example: Oxygen is an element found in air and water.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Each _____ depends on its environment to survive.”
challenges.explanation: “organism” means a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently. Example: Each organism depends on its environment to survive.

challenges.question: Which word means “the weather in some location averaged over some long period of time”?

challenges.question: Which word means “capable of adapting (of becoming or being made suitable) to a particular situation or use”?
challenges.explanation: “adaptable” means capable of adapting (of becoming or being made suitable) to a particular situation or use. Example: An adaptable learner can use different study strategies.

challenges.question: Which word means “having a strong desire for success or achievement”?
challenges.explanation: “ambitious” means having a strong desire for success or achievement. Example: The class set an ambitious goal for its reading challenge.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “Practice helped her feel _____ during the presentation.”
challenges.explanation: “confident” means having or marked by confidence or assurance. Example: Practice helped her feel confident during the presentation.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “A _____ student asks questions and explores new ideas.”
challenges.explanation: “curious” means eager to know or learn something. Example: A curious student asks questions and explores new ideas.

challenges.question: Which word means “quietly and steadily persevering especially in detail or exactness”?
challenges.explanation: “diligent” means quietly and steadily persevering especially in detail or exactness. Example: His diligent research uncovered several useful sources.

challenges.question: Which word means “willing to give and share unstintingly”?

challenges.question: Complete the example: “Give an _____ account of what happened.”
challenges.explanation: “honest” means not disposed to cheat or defraud. Example: Give an honest account of what happened.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The tutor remained _____ while the learner tried again.”
challenges.explanation: “patient” means enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance. Example: The tutor remained patient while the learner tried again.

challenges.question: Which word means “worthy of reliance or trust”?
challenges.explanation: “reliable” means worthy of reliance or trust. Example: A reliable source provides accurate, verifiable information.

challenges.question: Which word means “recovering readily from adversity, depression, or the like”?
challenges.explanation: “resilient” means recovering readily from adversity, depression, or the like. Example: The resilient team recovered from its early setback.

challenges.question: Which word means “expressing yourself easily or characterized by clear expressive language”?
challenges.explanation: “articulate” means expressing yourself easily or characterized by clear expressive language. Example: Her articulate response communicated a complex idea clearly.

challenges.question: Which word means “make clear and (more) comprehensible”?
challenges.explanation: “clarify” means make clear and (more) comprehensible. Example: Ask a follow-up question to clarify the instructions.

challenges.explanation: “collaborate” means to work together toward a shared goal. Example: The two classes collaborate on a community garden project.

challenges.explanation: “concise” means expressing much in few words. Example: A concise summary includes only the most important points.

challenges.question: Which word means “the formal presentation of a stated proposition and the opposition to it (usually followed by a vote)”?
challenges.explanation: “debate” means the formal presentation of a stated proposition and the opposition to it (usually followed by a vote). Example: Students debate whether the proposed solution is fair.

challenges.question: Which word means “give a description of”?
challenges.explanation: “describe” means give a description of. Example: Please describe what you observed during the experiment.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “The group will _____ the evidence before making a decision.”
challenges.explanation: “discuss” means to consider or examine in speech or writing. Example: The group will discuss the evidence before making a decision.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The campaign aims to _____ students to save water.”
challenges.explanation: “persuade” means cause somebody to adopt a certain position, belief, or course of action. Example: The campaign aims to persuade students to save water.

challenges.question: Which word means “to reply or react to something”?
challenges.explanation: “respond” means to reply or react to something. Example: Please respond to the question with a complete sentence.

challenges.question: Which word means “restate (words) from one language into another language”?
challenges.explanation: “translate” means restate (words) from one language into another language. Example: Can you translate this short message into English?

challenges.question: Which word means “make fit for, or change to suit a new purpose”?
challenges.explanation: “adapt” means make fit for, or change to suit a new purpose. Example: The group will adapt its plan after reviewing the feedback.

challenges.explanation: “develop” means to grow or change into a more advanced form. Example: Students develop stronger arguments through careful revision.

challenges.explanation: “emerge” means come out into view, as from concealment. Example: New themes emerge as the class examines the interviews.

challenges.explanation: “reduce” means to make something smaller or less. Example: Turning off unused lights can reduce energy consumption.

challenges.question: Which word means “to change greatly in form, appearance, or character”?

challenges.question: Which word means “a change from one place or state or subject or stage to another”?
challenges.explanation: “transition” means a change from one place or state or subject or stage to another. Example: A linking phrase creates a smooth transition between ideas.

challenges.question: Which word means “complicated in structure”?
challenges.explanation: “complex” means complicated in structure. Example: The team divided the complex problem into smaller steps.

challenges.question: Which word means “a serious disagreement or struggle”?
challenges.explanation: “conflict” means a serious disagreement or struggle. Example: The mediator helped both sides resolve the conflict.

challenges.question: Complete the example: “Soil erosion can be a _____ of removing too many trees.”
challenges.explanation: “consequence” means a result or effect of an action. Example: Soil erosion can be a consequence of removing too many trees.

challenges.explanation: “obstacle” means something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted. Example: Limited transport was an obstacle to attending the event.

challenges.explanation: “solution” means an answer to a problem or difficult situation. Example: The group tested more than one solution to the problem.

challenges.explanation: “strategy” means a carefully planned method for achieving a goal. Example: The team developed a strategy for completing the project on time.

challenges.question: Which word means “attain success or reach a desired goal”?
challenges.explanation: “succeed” means attain success or reach a desired goal. Example: Teams succeed when members communicate and share responsibility.

challenges.explanation: “urgent” means compelling immediate action. Example: The broken water pipe required urgent attention.
